hypothesis: Measure differential transverse, approximate QED, and Breit recoil corrections on the same saved 24 MCDHF spinors and five CI states to rank physical gaps; a large common core correction must not be mistaken for a transition correction.

fixed_conditions.basis: native RKB B-spline, exact saved Gauss workspace
fixed_conditions.exp_reference: same original NIST handbook nominals; no isotope uncertainty supplied

components.Dirac-Coulomb: public ci_solve on fixed common spinors, replay saved energies/amplitudes
components.static_Breit: public ci_solve include_breit=True, complete static Gaunt+retardation, replay saved RCI
components.dynamic_Breit: public ci_solve include_breit=True plus complete 24-key orbital energy map; each orbital epsilon is diagonal EOL Lagrange multiplier/(2 objective occupation) from saved same-state gradient, or the existing public zero-occupation one-body convention; symmetric average of two vertex |epsilon_a-epsilon_c| frequencies, real one-photon model replaces static Breit
components.dynamic_zero_frequency_check: same complete zero map must reproduce static Breit roots
components.Uehling: public short_range_radial_matrix and scalar_one_body_expectations; point-source local VP on fixed Fermi orbitals, finite-charge convolution absent
components.WK: public V_wichmann_kroll approximate local model and same full scalar CI expectation, not precision higher-loop VP
components.SE_default: public self_energy_radial_matrix(method=indelicato): tabulated K/L/available SD rows plus warned leading analytic fallback, orbital-attraction overlap screening; diagonal radial model, screened many-body/nonlocal terms absent
components.SE_local_discriminator: public shabaev_local matrix; actual local-model overlap for supported kappa -1,+1,-2 only; d/f components absent, no complete-SE claim
components.SE_full_coverage: public shabaev request records actual NotImplementedError; no missing term substituted
components.NMS: public one-body point-Coulomb Breit recoil radial/CSF matrix divided by A175 mass proxy; finite-size/radiative/higher-order recoil absent
components.SMS: public two-body point-Coulomb Breit recoil CSF matrix with Z=70, VINTI/SMS2/SMS3 divided by same mass; finite-size/radiative/higher-order recoil absent

stopping: Stop preserving failure if any saved identity/nucleus/replay numerical gate fails. Each unsupported correction remains explicitly unsupported. Stop at 900s/4GiB without reducing physical model or accepting failed stationarity.
